result.summary: Recovery completed after the predecessor's bridge stream-decoding interruption. Inspected first: latest main (40f8f68), worktree (only remote-queue/logs/queue.log dirty; no partial predecessor source edits), all four queue states, and the HermesRemoteQueuePoller scheduled task (Ready, 2-minute cadence). Predecessor agent-live-queue-recovery-deepseek-2026-09-23 confirmed terminally blocked (exit 3221225786 / 0xC000013A, output_bytes=0) and annotated with the stream-decode verdict plus successor linkage. Hermes confirmed on provider deepseek / model deepseek-flash (config.yaml:3-6); no secret values read or exposed. remote_queue/tests/test_queue.py rewritten to be fully isolated: HERMES_REPO_ROOT / HERMES_QUEUE_ROOT redirect every queue and git path (defaults unchanged), HERMES_POLLER_MUTEX gives an isolated poller its own mutex, publication is mocked or aimed at a throwaway bare origin, and guard tests assert isolation including a whole-suite live-queue live-state check. Four real lifecycle/dispatch defects were reproduced and minimally fixed under isolated tests only: (1) claim_task destroyed a task when publication raised (pending unlinked first, then the running copy deleted); (2) find_pending_tasks/get_running_tasks used the platform default codec so non-ASCII task JSON raised UnicodeDecodeError on Windows; (3) a push rejected because origin advanced (observed live 20:13:59Z) was never retried and left state unpublished; (4) an invalid pending task could never reach a terminal state because block_task raised and skipped the blocked/ copy. A diverged duplicate _git_commit_and_push in poller.py was removed in favour of one implementation. Stale running records reconciled from evidence: the orphaned agent-e3-integration-and-truth-reconciliation-2026-09-23 moved to blocked/ with commits 617e69cb and aae7d036 preserved and completion deliberately not inferred from code existing; the full-operational-build-2026-09-24 umbrella stays running and is annotated with the finding that its poller handler returns a hardcoded status, so it is not evidence of executed work. A reproducible evidence runner was added and run twice (identical results), and the unreproducible 207 aggregate was replaced with per-suite measurements. While this ran, the owner amended the authority (3838c61, baf73d8); state/tracker were corrected to record the standing CONDITIONAL local-only Stage 2 approval and the deferred architecture decision (laptop-primary recorded as a preference, not a decision). Stage 2 was NOT enabled, no deployment/cutover action was taken, and the repo tree is clean and synced with origin/main.
